_note: One line per Banking77 intent, written from the intent name's meaning for a fintech app. Deliberately NO example queries from the dataset: the teacher stays zero-shot. Used when label.py is run with --descriptions.
activate_my_card: how to activate a newly received card
age_limit: minimum age to open an account or get a card, accounts for children
apple_pay_or_google_pay: adding the card to or paying with Apple Pay / Google Pay
atm_support: which ATMs accept the card, ATM availability and support
automatic_top_up: setting up or changing automatic / recurring top-ups
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: a bank transfer INTO the account has not shown in the balance yet
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: a cheque or cash deposit has not shown in the balance yet
beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add or send to a specific beneficiary / payee
cancel_transfer: cancelling a transfer already made or in progress
card_about_to_expire: card is expiring soon, renewal or replacement card
card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, merchants or places that take it
card_arrival: when will the ordered card arrive, card has not come yet
card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery time estimate
card_linking: linking a card to the account or app
card_not_working: the card itself does not work at all, generally broken or unusable
card_payment_fee_charged: a fee was charged for a card payment
card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment on the statement the customer does not recognise
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: a card payment abroad used a wrong or unexpected exchange rate
card_swallowed: the ATM kept / swallowed the card
cash_withdrawal_charge: a fee was charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: an ATM cash withdrawal on the statement the customer did not make
change_pin: how to change the card PIN
compromised_card: card details may be compromised, suspected fraud on the card
contactless_not_working: contactless / tap payments specifically do not work
country_support: which countries the service or card is available in
declined_card_payment: a specific card payment was declined / refused
declined_cash_withdrawal: an ATM cash withdrawal was declined / refused
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit on the account the customer does not recognise
disposable_card_limits: limits on disposable virtual cards, how many can be created
edit_personal_details: changing name, address, phone or other personal details
exchange_rate: what exchange rate is used, current rate questions
exchange_via_app: how to exchange currencies inside the app
extra_charge_on_statement: an unexpected extra charge or fee on the statement
failed_transfer: a transfer failed / did not go through
fiat_currency_support: which fiat currencies are supported to hold or exchange
get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get a disposable single-use virtual card
get_physical_card: how to get a physical card, whether a physical card is available
getting_spare_card: getting an additional or spare card
getting_virtual_card: how to get a virtual card
lost_or_stolen_phone: phone with the app was lost or stolen
order_physical_card: ordering a physical card, the ordering process or its cost
passcode_forgotten: forgot the app passcode / login code
pending_card_payment: a card payment is still pending
pending_cash_withdrawal: an ATM cash withdrawal is still pending
pin_blocked: the PIN is blocked after wrong attempts
receiving_money: how to receive money from other people
Refund_not_showing_up: a refund that was promised has not appeared in the account
request_refund: how to request a refund for a payment
reverted_card_payment?: a card payment was reverted / reversed and the customer asks why
supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards and currencies can be used to top up
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: a fee for topping up by bank transfer
top_up_by_card_charge: a fee for topping up by card
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or a cheque
top_up_failed: a top-up failed / was not successful
top_up_reverted: a top-up was reverted / money went back
topping_up_by_card: how to top up using a card, which cards can top up
transaction_charged_twice: a transaction was charged twice / duplicate charge
transfer_fee_charged: a fee was charged for a transfer
transfer_into_account: how to transfer money INTO this account from a bank
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: a transfer was sent but the recipient has not received it
unable_to_verify_identity: identity verification is failing or cannot be completed
verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, the verification process
verify_source_of_funds: being asked to verify the source of funds
virtual_card_not_working: a virtual card specifically does not work
visa_or_mastercard: is the card Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: the ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: an ATM withdrawal abroad used a wrong exchange rate
